passive.name: Mark of the Kindred
passive.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

spells.name: Dance of Arrows
spells.description: Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing physical damage and gaining Attack Speed for seconds. While inside of Wolf's Frenzy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Wolf's Frenzy
spells.description: Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to Health based on their missing Health. Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal plus current Health magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BaseWolfDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Mounting Dread
spells.description: Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by % for second. Kindred's third Attack against the target within seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional plus missing Health physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BaseBiteDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Lamb's Respite
spells.description: Kindred blesses the ground for seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for Health.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
